about: What sessions need from the owner, newest first. A session appends an entry here and rebuilds the dashboard (README.md). The owner ticks it on the dashboard; the tick lives in the artifact database as items/req-<id>. Never put an id, key or password in this file: say where it goes.

requests.title: Create the AdMob account and put the three ids into ads.env
requests.detail: The app's ads are built and show Google's test ads until apps/mobile/ads.env holds your App ID and two banner unit ids (phase 4: admob-account, admob-units, ads-env). Also the pub- id into Vercel for app-ads.txt. Ids never go into chat.
requests.where: Dashboard phase 4, items admob-account, admob-units, ads-env, app-ads-txt

requests.title: Use the new Play answers: Ads = Yes, and the four Data safety rows
requests.detail: docs/store/data-safety-and-declarations.md was rewritten for ADR-076. The forms and data-safety items in phase 5 carry the exact rows. Nothing to send back unless the Console's wording differs.
requests.where: Dashboard phase 5, items forms and data-safety

requests.title: Run the Play Billing check once on a real phone
requests.detail: The signed build carries the billing library without the INTERNET permission (proved in the build). Only a phone can show whether the library complains. Item billing-probe in phase 6 has the exact steps; send the session the one line the app shows and any SecurityException from adb logcat.

requests.title: Give a session the URL of the one-question feedback form
requests.detail: Routine R4 links to it from the weekly posts and the app's store listing reply template. The form must warn 'do not include health details'. Any form tool works; only the URL is needed.
requests.where: Item feedback-form in phase 2; then tell a session the URL

requests.title: Answer the four content questions
requests.detail: Three Arabic editing decisions in docs/content/reviews/2026-10-28-arabic-editor-pass.md and one clinical one: a source for bleeding and reduced movements on the pregnancy red-flag list, or leave them off. Item content-decisions in phase 2.
requests.where: Dashboard item content-decisions; answers in chat

requests.title: Create the Canva account so a session can build the six templates
requests.detail: The Canva connector is attached to this project but needs your account signed in. Item canva in phase 7.
